caption: The drawing depicts a central black bird with an orange beak and orange legs, standing slightly to the right but facing left, placed against a reddish-brown rectangular background. Surrounding the bird are four stylized floral or leafy shapes, each consisting of yellow, orange, and green elements, positioned in each corner of the inner rectangle. The inner rectangular area is bordered by a thin yellow line and a slightly outer layer of green, which runs horizontally across the upper section. The corners of the outermost rectangle feature gray, bracket-like shapes that partially intrude into the reddish-brown area. The entire composition is framed by a thin border of off-white or beige.
title: Painted Chest
